axiombase.description: AxiomBase Logic Server — deterministic reasoning, truth maintenance, and agent memory management for AI agents

env_vars.AXIOMBASE_API_KEY: Your AxiomBase API key. Generate via POST /auth/bootstrap (first time) or POST /auth/keys (admin). Required when AUTH_ENABLED=true.

auth_modes.disabled: No API key needed. Set no env vars.
auth_modes.legacy: Set API_KEY on the server. Use the same key in X-API-Key header.
auth_modes.rbac: Set AUTH_ENABLED=true on server. Bootstrap first key via POST /auth/bootstrap, then use that key.

tools: tell — Store facts (with optional TTL/temporal bounds)
ask — Run backward-chaining inference with optional proofs
recall — Time-travel queries at specific timestamps
context — Salience-ranked context window for agent reasoning
cleanup — Decay and eviction of stale/low-salience facts
predicates — Schema discovery (list all predicate types)
